Maneka Gandhi (1978) held the procedure must be 'just, fair and reasonable'.
Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides protection of life and personal liberty?
q1472: Silappadikaram, one of the Five Great Epics of Tamil literature, was composed by Ilango Adigal; it tells the story of Kannagi and Kovalan.

Who composed the famous Tamil epic Silappadikaram?
q1478: Amla (Indian gooseberry) is famous for Vitamin C, not Vitamin A. Carrot, mango and papaya are rich in beta-carotene, which gives Vitamin A.
Lack of Vitamin A causes night blindness.
Which of the following is NOT a rich source of Vitamin A?
q1479: Henry Louis Vivian Derozio, a teacher at Hindu College, Calcutta, inspired the radical Young Bengal Movement (1820s–30s).
Derozio was dismissed from Hindu College in 1831.
Who among the following started the Young Bengal Movement in Calcutta?
q1480: Oranges and lemons contain citric acid.
Tomato: oxalic acid. Ant sting: methanoic (formic) acid. Curd: lactic acid.
Which of the following acids is found in orange?
q1481: Article 65 lets the Vice President act as President when the office falls vacant (until a new election, within six months) or when the President is absent or ill.

In India, 2 October is Gandhi Jayanti, a national holiday.
On which date is the International Day of Non-Violence observed?

The Himalayas run about 2,400 km from the Indus to the Brahmaputra.

It was the first Indo-Aryan language after Sanskrit to get the status.

When were the Morley–Minto Reforms passed by the British Parliament?
q1495: Astra Mk-1 is an indigenous beyond-visual-range air-to-air missile developed by DRDO for the Indian Air Force.
Akash is surface-to-air; BrahMos is a supersonic cruise missile.
q1496: All three are right: regular salaried employees get wages regularly; self-employed people own and run their own enterprise; construction workers are typically casual wage labourers.
In India most workers are self-employed.

Scurvy: Vitamin C. Pellagra: B3 (niacin). Pernicious anaemia: B12.
q1499: Fertility rates are calculated for women of reproductive age, 15 to 49 years.
A total fertility rate of 2.1 is replacement level; India's TFR is 2.0 (NFHS-5).
q1500: Impeachment charges against the President must be signed by at least one-fourth of the members of the House where they start, after 14 days' notice (Article 61).

The Preamble is based on Nehru's Objectives Resolution (1946).
q1502: The spread (net interest margin) is the gap between the interest banks charge borrowers and the interest they pay depositors.

Article 75 deals with the appointment of the PM and ministers.
q1505: The marginal rate of technical substitution (MRTS) is how much of one input (say capital) a firm can give up for one more unit of another (labour) while keeping output the same.
It is the slope of an isoquant.
